result.title: Making MLLM Latents Matter: Factor-Aware Predictive Learning for Cinematic Video Generation
result.summary: Cinematic video generation requires both temporal inference from limited inputs (i.e., sparse rather than frame-by-frame guidance) and factor-aware control of character, scene, action, and camera. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer useful priors for both capabilities, but their representations are not automatically actionable for video generation: a Video Diffusion Transformer (DiT) may bypass them through native conditioning pathways, and using them does not ensure either factor-aware control or generation-compatible temporal prediction. We propose Factor-Aware Predictive Learning (FAPL), which establishes effective MLLM latent use as a shared prerequisite and then targets the two capabilities with complementary learning signals. First, latent-only generator grounding trains the DiT with a frozen MLLM and connector, strengthening the DiT's use of MLLM latents for generation. Second, for factor-aware control, paired videos specify a target-factor change and non-target preservation, and factor-span replacement trains the DiT to realize this relationship in its output. Third, for temporal inference, text-only and text-plus-complete-video observations share a video target, and the trained DiT is then frozen while the MLLM and connector are optimized through it. This final stage trains limited-input representations for generation while retaining complete-observation reconstruction as a complementary training mode. Extensive experiments demonstrate our consistently better performance on three cinematic video generation tasks (i.e., sparse-to-video, factor-aware editing, and multi-shot generation) over baselines and validate FAPL's contributions to MLLM feature use, temporal control, and factor coordination.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Factor-Aware Predictive Learning（FAPL），面向电影化视频生成：先用冻结 MLLM 做 latent-only 接地训练 DiT，再借配对视频与 factor-span replacement 训练角色、场景、动作、镜头的因素级控制，最后冻结 DiT 反传优化 MLLM 与 connector，使稀疏输入表示支持生成式时序预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「防止 DiT 经原生条件通路绕过 MLLM 表示」的 latent-only 接地，以及冻结下游生成器反传训练表示的做法，可供核查 LVR 中的视觉旁路、latent 是否真被使用与贡献分配问题；但任务是视频生成而非推理，迁移需较多核查。
